title: the RPC observation contract of the #66 runner (#85)
written: 2026-10-15, lane rpc-85 (S4b); every cite read at the pins with git show, never a working tree

findings.title: the registration names getmerkleproof2's arguments txid, blockhash; the handler reads blockhash at position 0 and txid at 1
getblock verbosity 0 on a pruned block writes a 200 head and a partial chunk, then a second HTTP response carrying -1

edges.title: the only transaction of a one-transaction block has an empty proof, which both proof handlers answer as -5 Transaction(s) not found in provided block
-testsafemode refuses the okSafeMode-false handlers with -2 while getsafemodeinfo answers safemodeenabled false
timeutc is the wall clock under a mock clock, while block times and the pool's acceptance times follow the mock clock

envelope.transport: one HTTP/1.1 POST per call, cookie auth (src/httprpc.cpp:291-311); the reply {result, error, id}
